title: Button
description: A four-hole button sewn on with two crossing stitches.
alt: An outlined round button with four holes. Two peach stitches are drawn diagonally between the holes one after the other, the button dips at each pull, then the thread is removed.
note: Describing the interaction as a physical event, each stitch pulls the button down a little, gives the press its timing for free. The first version drew the thread far thicker than everything else; it now has the same weight as the outline. Review also caught the two stitches leaving at once where the prompt asked for one after the other.
author: Maria Roszyk
